name: Mengxue Hou
title: Assistant Professor
department: Electrical Engineering; Robotics and Autonomy Research Lab
fitReason: Strong AI-and-control overlap spanning learned underwater manipulation, probabilistic perception, and robotic planning under uncertainty.

physicalEvidence.summary: Coauthor of AquaBot (October 2024 preprint, ICRA 2025): a real QYSEA FIFISH V-EVO with gripper executes behavior-cloned visuomotor policies and surrogate-guided speed optimization for grasping, sorting and mannequin retrieval in a pool. Compute is tethered/offboard; external cameras assist localization/reset and PID handles sorting navigation. This is collaboration-level evidence, not confirmed current ND-owned AquaBot equipment. ND separately documents its own MUR field robot, but May 2026 reporting explicitly places the uncertainty-aware 3DGS evaluation in HoloOcean and field transfer as ongoing.
